subject.title: fix(agents): preserve runtime tool inheritance tokens

question: After the branch is refreshed, should OpenClaw preserve filtered runtime selector tokens in inherited child-session allowlists, or move this fix to a different runtime materialization boundary?
rationale: The PR changes the child-session tool authorization boundary, and the current branch conflicts with newer policy code, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent boundary or approve the merge result.

options.title: Refresh And Land Selector Preservation
options.body: Resolve conflicts while keeping declared allowlist and cron capture behavior, then land if owner review confirms the selectors are filtered through the same effective policy layers as materialized tools.

options.title: Accept After Security Review
options.body: Maintainers may land the refreshed branch if they judge the supplied runtime proof and tests sufficient for this authorization boundary.

options.title: Replace At Runtime Boundary
options.body: Pause this PR and implement an owner-authored alternative closer to MCP/LSP runtime materialization if selector persistence in session state is not the desired contract.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land Selector Preservation
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts while keeping declared allowlist and cron capture behavior, then land if owner review confirms the selectors are filtered through the same effective policy layers as materialized tools.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent declared allowlist work overlaps the active conflict area in tool-policy and gateway-resolution code.
